name: tpl-precedence-1-goal~p3
task: First move the ball off the door, then take the key, open the door with it and pick up the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task orders four events: move the ball, take the key, open the door, pick up the box. Existence(target_picked_up) plus the three hard Precedence clauses form a complete chain, so the Existence forces door_open, has_door_key and blocker_moved in that order. No earlier step has a redundant Existence, and every clause traces to a stated step.

texts: Pick up the target box (the required final goal of the ordered sequence).
The door must not be opened before the key is taken (open the door with the key).
The box must not be picked up before the door is open.
The key must not be taken before the ball has been moved off the door.
